title: Zebra Android 14 must be configured to enable audit logging.
check_content:
Inspect the configuration on the managed Zebra Android 14 device to enable audit logging.

This validation procedure is performed only on the EMM Administration Console. 

On the EMM console:

COBO and COPE:

1. Open "Device owner management" section.
2. Verify that "Enable security logging" is toggled to "ON".

If the EMM console device policy is not set to enable audit logging, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure the Zebra Android 14 device to enable audit logging.

On the EMM console:

COBO and COPE:

1. Open "Device owner management" section.
2. Toggle "Enable security logging" to "ON".
VulnDiscussion:
Audit logs enable monitoring of security-relevant events and subsequent forensics when breaches occur. To be useful, administrators must have the ability to view the audit logs.

SFR ID: FMT_SMF_EXT.1.1 #32
